description: Use this when someone asks who their members are, or needs a member's id to book them, update their details or look up their sessions. Returns up to 100 members (20 by default) across all the user's gyms or one, with id, name, gym and last edit time, optionally only those whose name matches. Not for a member's email, phone or notes.

gymId.description: Only members of this gym, by an id from the user's gym list; every gym when absent

limit.description: Maximum number of members to return (default 20, maximum 100)

search.description: Only members whose name contains these words, in any order, ignoring case and accents

name: list_members

members.description: Members with the ids needed to book them or look up their sessions. Email, phone, address, date of birth, notes, attendance and payment history, organization data and other profile fields are excluded.

lastEditTime.description: Version to pass as expectedLastEditTime when updating the member's details

title: Look up gym members
